_comment: Expected-value weights for policy_v2. Shape follows rocom-helper's
src/analysis/tactical/scoring.py so the two can be compared directly,
but every number here is a starting guess - the point of putting them in
a file is that they get fitted from turns.jsonl once results are logged.
Units: all terms are clamped to 0..1 before weighting, so weights are
_note_buff: 2026-11-21 晚重测：旧 buff 模型（虚构的每层 +20% 攻防、可叠 3 层）给出 66.5%，但 roco-cal 真实数据里 buff 是【一次性固定值、不可叠、攻防是不同技能】。换成真实模型（+70% 攻、不加防）后：无条件叠 13.7%，纯贪心 50.3%，【预计还能活 2 回合以上才叠】61.3%。所以加了 buff_need_turns 门槛。
_note_buff_bonus: buff_bonus 现在只影响 self_buff 的兜底得分（不再无条件优先）。旧值 0.10 是在虚构模型下搜出来的，保留但不作主判据。
